scope.zh: 网络安全入侵：入侵、神经学防火墙或重启的小支线。
scope.en: Cyber Security Breach: the small branch of intrusion, neurological firewalls or reboot.

texts.zh:
最近，有几份机密文件被远程服务器非法下载。我们的安全人员坚持认为所有的主防火墙和二级防火墙都完好无损，到目前为止也没有外部网络攻击的证据。

但结论无可逃避：我们中出了个叛徒，而且鉴于这些信息的敏感程度，他一定有着很高的权限。
texts.en:
Recently, several classified documents were illegally downloaded by a remote server. Our security operatives are adamant that all primary and secondary firewalls remain intact, and so far there is no evidence of an external cyber attack.

The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak, and given the sensitive nature of the stolen information, it must be someone with high-level clearance.

texts.zh:
最近，有几份机密文件被远程服务器非法下载。我们的安全人员坚持认为所有的主防火墙和二级防火墙都完好无损，到目前为止也没有外部网络攻击的证据。

但结论无可逃避：我们有漏洞——这个漏洞让我们接受开源义体强化件的决定受到质疑。
texts.en:
Recently, several classified documents were illegally downloaded by a remote server. Our security operatives are adamant that all primary and secondary firewalls remain intact, and so far there is no evidence of an external cyber attack.

The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak - one that casts our decision to embrace open-sourced cybernetic augmentation into doubt.

texts.zh:
对义体安全漏洞的调查获得了结论。

我们已经锁定了一种强化件和一些政府高级官员，他们的神经学湿件遭到了入侵。外国特工对其进行操作，并强迫他们违背自己的意志行动，这些个体对上述事件没有任何记忆。

尽管我们已经知道了泄露的原因，但我们对究竟是谁——或什么东西——进行了窃密仍一筹莫展。然而，通过秘密向那些受影响的官员意识中植入错误信息，我们也许可以追溯到窃密源。
texts.en:
The investigation into our cyber security leak has concluded.

Certain augmented and high-level officials within the government have been targeted, their neurological wetware hacked. Manipulated by external agents and forced to act against their will, these individuals have no memory of the events in question.

Although we now know the cause of the leak, we are no closer to discovering who - or what - was ultimately responsible. However, by surreptitiously implanting false data into the minds of the affected officials, we may be able to trace the leak back to its source.

tooltips.zh: 随机数量的义体人领袖获得义体傀儡特质。
tooltips.en: A random number of Cyborg Leaders have gained the Cyber Puppet Trait.

texts.zh:
找到了。

藏身于本次史无前例网络攻击背后的犯罪分子已经被找到了。这些自称为“精神劫持者”的人除了制造混乱没有其他目的，他们能游刃有余地绕过我们的安全系统。虽然主犯已经被拘留，但我们仍然必须决定如何处理我们受侵害的官员。

最简单的解决方案是在受影响的植入体周围安装自定义防火墙。而还有一个更干净、但风险更大的选择是硬重启：通过进入上述领袖的基础认知功能，重新安装操作系统，期间这些领袖会被强制“关机”。
texts.en:
We have them.

The criminals behind the unprecedented cyber attacks have been found. With no goal other than the sowing of chaos, these self-proclaimed 'Mind Jackers' managed to circumvent our security systems with embarrassing ease. While the ringleaders are already in custody, we must still decide what to do with our compromised officials.

The simplest solution is to install a custom firewall around their affected implants. A cleaner, though more risky, option is a hard reboot: accessing their base cognitive functions, the leaders in question could be forcibly 'shut down' while a new operating system is installed.

label.zh: 我们被贼惦记上了。建立防火墙。
label.en: They're onto us. Build the wall.

texts.zh:
我们的意识安全了。

湿件工程师成功地设计出了神经学防火墙。为了维持我们的集体安全，我们目前和未来的所有官员立刻安装上了这些程序。尽管这会对我们的领导阶层的基础认知功能造成影响，但这项工程也对数据安全科学带来了卓著的洞见。
texts.en:
Our minds are safe.

Wetware engineers have successfully designed a neurological firewall. In order to maintain our collective security, the program will be immediately installed in all current and future officials. While this will have a detrimental impact on the base cognitive functionality of our leadership class, the project has provided significant insight into the science of data security.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 所有义体人领袖移除义体傀儡特质，并添加神经防火墙特质。
tooltips.en: Removes the Cyber Puppet Trait and Applies the Neurological Firewall Trait to all Cyborg leaders.

texts.zh:
我们对入侵的官员的硬重启导致了一些意想不到的后果：虽然抹去了所有神经系统入侵的痕迹，但他们积累的一大部分知识和经验也随之而去。

尽管遭遇挫折，但在“重新开始”的过程中，这些领袖表示自己在职业和个人方面都获得了深刻的新生。通过迫使我们采取如此激烈的措施，黑客们可能无意中帮了我们一个忙。
texts.en:
The hard reboot of our compromised officials has resulted in some unexpected consequences: every trace of the neurological hack has been wiped clean, but so too has a great portion of their accumulated knowledge and experience.

Despite this setback, in 'starting fresh' these leaders report deep feelings of professional and personal renewal. By forcing us to take such drastic measures, the hackers may have unintentionally done us a favor.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh:
移除具有义体傀儡特质领袖的所有负面特质。
每移除一项特质造成300经验值的损失。
tooltips.en:
Removes all Negative Traits from Leaders with the Cyber Puppet Trait.
For each Trait removed, 300 Experience will be lost.

# 义体安全漏洞 / Cyber Security Breach

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:5274-5535`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链后段：工作/家庭事件结束后隐藏事件 cyber.1000 从 on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list（7个事件，权重各5：休闲 1005/1010/1030/1055，社会 1205/1210/1255）抽取一个。
  Late part of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the work/family event hidden cyber.1000 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list (7 events, weight 5 each: leisure 1005/1010/1030/1055, society 1205/1210/1255).
- 无额外触发条件。
  No extra trigger.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1255「网络安全入侵」→ 180+随机60天 1260「神经操控」（leak_distrust；有赛博格/被黑客领袖会受影响）→ 360+随机60天 1265「精神劫持者」→ a/c 360+随机60天 1275「神经学防火墙」（设 firewall_built，可得研究选项）；b 90+随机5天 1270「重启，更新」。
  1255 "Cyber Security Breach" -> 1260 "Neuromancy" after 180 days (+ random 60) (leak_distrust; cyborg / hacked leaders are affected) -> 1265 "Mind Jackers" after 360 (+ random 60) -> a/c 1275 "Neurological Firewalls" after 360 (+ random 60) (sets firewall_built, may give a research option); b 1270 "Rebooted; Renewed" after 90 (+ random 5).
- 事件结束后180+随机90天由隐藏事件 cyber.1500 按政体权威选出最终事件 1505–1525 之一（跨故事的共享结局，视为枢纽）。
  After 180 days (+ random 90) hidden cyber.1500 picks one of the final events 1505-1525 by government authority (a shared ending across stories, treated as a hub).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1270 与 1275 互斥（取决于1265的选项）。
  1270 and 1275 are exclusive (by the 1265 option).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 领袖特质 leader_trait_cyborg / leader_trait_hacked 影响后果。
  Leader traits leader_trait_cyborg / leader_trait_hacked affect the outcome.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：链顺序与延迟、衔接到 cyber.1500。
  Checked: chain order and delays, the link to cyber.1500.
